Natural Amethyst Cathedral Geode
Standing Quartz Crystal Cluster Specimen
Deep Purple Quartz, Approximately 6.8 Inches Tall, 3.6 Pounds
This natural amethyst cathedral geode specimen features a cavity of vibrant, deep purple crystalline quartz points bordered by a banded agate perimeter and a natural rock matrix. Cut with a flat base, it stands freely for display on a tabletop, shelf, or mineral cabinet. Natural amethyst geodes form within volcanic cavities, creating striking geological display pieces highly prized by mineral collectors and interior decorators alike.
Features dense, lustrous purple quartz crystal points inside an open geode cavity
Natural rock exterior with cut flat base for stable, upright display
Polished boundary rim highlights the transition from matrix to crystal cluster
Measures approximately 6.8 inches tall by 4.2 inches wide; weighs approximately 3.6 pounds
Condition:
Excellent natural mineral condition. Crystal points are sharp, vibrant, and well-formed with deep violet coloration. Natural surface variations, internal fissures, and rough textures inherent to geological specimens are present on the matrix back and sides. Cut base is flat and stable.
